jobs.prompt: Field report from parts-request-app (swarm 1.150.0), three autopilot bugs. BUG 1: read-only runs (every swarm ask and every review job, runs whose jobs all have outputs: []) are complete but never count as integrated, so decide() in tools/autopilot.mjs (about line 123) returns integrate for them forever and, with a dirty checkout, raises the integrate-checkout-RUN blocker again after every resolve (7 times in an hour). The flag comes from tools/brief.mjs line 75: integrated: Boolean(state.integratedFiles?.length) || state.integrated === true. Fix: a run counts as integrated when state.integratedFiles has entries, or state.integrated === true, or state.integratedAt is set, or the run declares no outputs (every job outputs is empty: a pure helper runHasNoOutputs(state) in tools/run-kind.mjs, reuse isNonIntegratingRun there); independently decide() never returns integrate for ask runs (run ids or jobs named ask) or nonIntegrating runs or runs without outputs, and no integrate-checkout blocker is raised for them even on a dirty tree. Regression tests: a complete run with outputs [] and integratedAt set gives decide() null and no blocker on a dirty tree; an ask run never integrates; a run with outputs still integrates; the resolved-blocker rule from 1.165.0 still holds. BUG 2: autopilot retry-failed (tools/autopilot.mjs about lines 384 to 393 and 511) starts a duplicate run for a failed run that the orchestrator already re-ran by hand and integrated. Fix: before retry-failed, skip a failed run when another run with the same manifest (same manifest hash) and the same job ids, or the same declared outputs, is already complete or integrated; add the command swarm resolve RUN_ID --handled that marks a failed run handled (recorded in the run state and the journal, owner or agent allowed because it only stops retries) which decide() honors; the retry never starts for a handled run. Tests: duplicate-completed skip by manifest hash, by outputs, handled flag honored, a failed run with no sibling still retries once. BUG 3 (smaller): with autopilot running, git switch fails repeatedly with local changes would be overwritten because every poll regenerates coordination/HANDOFF.md and appends to TASK.md and the journal. 1.165.0 already stops HANDOFF.md rewrites when only the timestamp changed. Check what else changes on a quiet poll (TASK.md appends, journal lines, usage ledger, docs/scope/build-plan.md): a poll with no state change must write nothing tracked or untracked-generated (no journal line, no TASK.md append, no HANDOFF write); a test runs two autopilot --once polls on an unchanged project and asserts no file changes (bytes and mtime) in the project outside .swarm/runs locks; fix whatever still writes. Keep every existing test passing (change a test only where intended behavior changes, with a comment). Never import install.mjs statically from new modules. Hermetic tests (no ambient environment, no TTY, no network, injected clock). No token-shaped literals and no URL with credentials. ignoreTests reason: only the named files and their tests change; the fixture ledger is a frozen data copy.
